fullDescription: Builds the new membership registration review interface traced to 1777781281647-hz7g5mgy2b8.jpeg, including the branded top bars, step sidebar, personal data summary, contact and address sections, secondary membership cards, and footer action bar. The component is reusable for membership onboarding or review flows that need a read-only summary with prominent navigation and action buttons.

Builds the membership search landing interface traced to 1777781280776-hz85g27aqjj.jpeg, including the compact branded header, two large action tiles for starting a new membership or checking pending processes, and a centered membership lookup form with a disabled submit state. The component is reusable for customer service or onboarding flows that need a lightweight entry screen before opening detailed membership forms.

Renders the membership verification experience shown in 1777781279681-hbeprvw275k.jpeg as a centered modal-like overlay on a muted background. The view uses the shared MembershipVerificationDialog component to present member rows, verification status indicators, one-time code inputs, resend actions, and a final Done button.

Displays a compact verification dialog for confirming multiple memberships by contact method, including a header icon, explanatory copy, verified and pending member states, four-digit code entry blocks, resend code links, and a primary completion action. The component is reusable across customer service or onboarding flows that need to verify several related members inside a modal or overlay context.
